predictions.rationale: Primary class representing a UML State Diagram within the original ArgoUML application module; central for creation, storage and manipulation of state diagrams.
Implements the graph model for state diagrams, managing nodes/states and transitions; core to the underlying behavior representation.
Responsible for rendering graphical elements of state diagrams (states, transitions) onto the canvas; directly supports visual aspect of the feature.
Registers tools, actions and factories required for state diagram functionality during application start-up; initializes the feature.
Defines the user action/menu command to create a new State Diagram; key entry point from the UI.
Provides the property panel for editing/viewing State Diagram attributes; directly supports user interaction with the feature.
Factory that supplies the property panel specific to State Diagrams; ties diagram instances to their UI panels.
Equivalent class for the newer 'state2' diagram subsystem; represents State Diagram objects in the modularized implementation.
Factory that creates State Diagram instances in the state2 module, essential for constructing diagrams under the new architecture.
Graph model for State Diagrams in the state2 module; manages the behavioral elements and relations in redesigned implementation.
